''See also: [[Rojric Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Rojric [[Marten]] is a man characterized by his red [[Izyrian]] hair and a closely trimmed red beard. He is the father of [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]]. Rojric's history involves being arrested by [[Watch-leader Fitch]] for attempting to buy stolen property belonging to the Emperor. While held in custody, he experienced periods of improved health due to regular meals and medical care at a facility in [[Candle Bay]], though he also endured significant suffering. During his imprisonment, Rojric suffered intense physical and mental agony, at one point attempting to end his own life to escape further pain. He was eventually brought before the Emperor, where he was sentenced to death and subsequently died following a piercing shriek. His son later recounted that Rojric's imprisonment was triggered by the theft of a pen and that he had been subjected to experiments by [[Alchemists|alchemists]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Rojric [[Marten]] possesses pale skin and red [[Izyrian]] hair.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Rojric is the father of [[Calder]]. He was also killed following orders issued by the Emperor.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Rojric [[Marten]], the father of [[Calder]], was initially reported as missing. It was later revealed that he had been taken and held as a prisoner within the [[Candle Bay Imperial Prison]] and Reformative Facility. While incarcerated in a cell, the man with pale skin and red [[Izyrian]] hair met his end. His death was marked by an audible shriek that sounded as if it were tearing the world in half.}}
